scope: deterministic production-readiness configuration and evidence gate

acceptance.criterion: Unresolved critical auth/data-loss/duplicate-side-effect findings fail the gate
RTO/RPO require positive targets and denominators
Retention, recovery window, observability and operational artifacts are checked
Duplicate-side-effect, retention-gap, audit and security regression cases fail when supplied evidence fails
Rollback requires legacy path, canary flag, owner and successful drill

verification.regression_command: ai-service/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q tests/test_p8_migration_boundary.py tests/test_p8_migration_parity.py tests/test_p6_event_ui_convergence.py tests/test_p5_api_security.py tests/test_p4_execution_adapters.py tests/test_p3_persistence_events.py tests/test_p2_hitl_state.py tests/test_p1_canonical_model.py tests/test_p0_contract_baseline.py
verification.warning: PytestCacheWarning: .pytest_cache path was not writable on Windows

limitations: PASS chỉ chứng minh các evidence/configuration bounded được cung cấp; không chứng minh deployment, HA, live traffic hoặc recovery production.
Runbook, dashboard, alert và rollback references mới được kiểm tra như artifact/config, chưa được probe từ hạ tầng thật.
Load/soak và chaos execution production vẫn cần chạy ngoài unit test.
